topic:
Boi canh: repo task-manager (D:\coding\personal-tools\task-manager), nhanh main, sach. App desktop
Node.js/Express/SQLite chay local (dong goi thanh 1 file exe bang node --experimental-sea-config, nguoi
dung 1 nguoi/1 may, khong co server public, khong co dang nhap nhieu nguoi dung). Vua hoan tat 1 dot
tach module lon (CR-20260912-xoa-ai-automation-tai-cau-truc + CR-20260912-tach-module-fe-schema-db) -
xoa het AI automation, tach server/db.ts thanh 8 file schema + tach src/main.tsx thanh cac man rieng
theo tinh nang (Task ca nhan/Project/Weekly/Release/Luyen de/MindMap/Settings).

Yeu cau cua Leader (nguyen van): "council review lai tong the kien truc cua tool 1 lan nua dung tren
quan diem security, de mo rong va cac setting cho cac chuc nang da phu hop chua, neu co thi giai quyet
luon".

Day la PHIEN THIET KE/RA SOAT THAT (khong phai lam demo) - Council PHAI tu doc code that (khong doan),
roi de xuat danh sach van de THAT kem cach sua cu the. KHONG duoc bay ve nhung rui ro ly thuyet chung
chung ("nen co auth", "nen dung HTTPS") ma khong gan voi boi canh THAT cua 1 app desktop 1 nguoi dung
chay local - phai tu hoi "voi app nay, rui ro nay co that khong, ai khai thac duoc, khai thac the nao".

Ba khia canh can ra soat:

1. SECURITY (bao mat):
   - Server bind o dau (chi 127.0.0.1 hay 0.0.0.0)? Neu bind 0.0.0.0 thi may khac trong cung mang co
     goi duoc API khong (doc server/index.ts).
   - Cach luu API key Redmine (server/routes/redmine.ts, server/lib/secret.ts) - ma hoa the nao, key ma
     hoa nam o dau, co the giai ma duoc tu file khac tren may khong (vd co hardcode key ma hoa/giai ma
     trong source code khong, hay dung DPAPI/keytar hay tu viet AES voi key co dinh trong code - neu key
     co dinh trong code thi ma hoa gan nhu vo nghia, ai doc duoc source la giai ma duoc).
   - Cac route co input validation khong - dac biet cac route nhan free-text roi ghi thang vao SQL (grep
     toan bo `db.prepare`/`db.exec` xem co cho nao noi chuoi truc tiep tu input nguoi dung vao cau SQL
     khong dung parameterized query - SQL injection that neu co).
   - File upload/attachment (mindmap, task link) - co gioi han loai file, kich thuoc, co the ghi de file
     he thong qua path traversal khong (doc server/lib/mindmap-gc.ts va route lien quan upload/luu file).
   - CORS config trong server/app.ts - co mo qua rong khong (allow tat ca origin) trong khi server co
     the bind ra ngoai 127.0.0.1.
   - Bat ky endpoint nao thuc thi shell command / spawn process khong (grep child_process/exec/spawn) -
     neu co thi input dua vao co duoc sanitize khong.
   - electron/build-sea.mjs va cac script dong goi - co lo bi mat gi (API key, token) vao source/exe
     khong.

2. KHA NANG MO RONG (extensibility) - tiep noi dot tach module vua roi:
   - Con diem nao trong kien truc hien tai se lam kho khi them 1 tinh nang moi (vi du: them 1 man hinh
     moi co can sua nhieu cho khong lien quan khong, co "god file" nao con lai ngoai nhung cai da biet
     (mappers.ts, projects.ts ghi weekly_goals - da ghi trong backlog roi, KHONG can nhac lai) khong.
   - Kiem tra server/app.ts - dang ky route co theo mau nao ro rang de them route moi khong lac nhau
     khong.
   - Kiem tra co pattern nao dang bi lap lai nhieu lan (>=3 cho) ma le ra nen rut thanh 1 ham/module dung
     chung khong (ngoai nhung cai da liet ke trong BL-20260818-006/008 - CHi neu THEM neu tim thay cai
     MOI, khong lap lai audit cu).

3. SETTINGS CHO TUNG CHUC NANG DA PHU HOP CHUA:
   - Sau khi tach man Settings (settings.tsx) thanh 4 muc con (PIC, Redmine, Category, Phim tat) - xem
     lai cau truc nay co dung "moi setting nam dung cho tinh nang so huu no" khong, hay con setting nao
     dang nam sai cho (vi du 1 setting cua tinh nang X lai phai vao qua man Settings chung thay vi nam
     ngay trong man cua tinh nang X, hoac nguoc lai).
   - Redmine config (API key/URL) hien la setting DUNG CHUNG (global) - co tinh nang nao can setting
     RIENG theo tung boi canh (vd moi project 1 cau hinh khac) ma dang bi ep dung chung khong? Kiem tra
     that qua code cach Redmine duoc dung o dau (grep server/routes/redmine.ts consumer).
   - Co thieu 1 man Settings/cau hinh nao ma nguoi dung se can nhung hien khong co cho nao de sua (vi du:
     doi duong dan luu file dinh kem, doi ngon ngu, backup/restore thu cong) - CHi de xuat neu thay bang
     chung ro rang trong code (vd hang so hardcode le ra nen cau hinh duoc), khong doan mo ho.

Yeu cau ve quy trinh:
- Doc code THAT qua Read/Grep, khong doan ten ham/bien.
- Neu tim thay van de THAT (khong phai y kien chung chung), liet ke: file, dong, van de, muc do rui ro
  that voi boi canh app 1 nguoi dung/local, cach sua cu the.
- Phan biet ro "van de that co the khai thac" voi "thuc hanh tot nhung khong co rui ro that trong boi
  canh nay" - khong de xuat sua nhung thu khong co rui ro that chi vi "best practice noi chung".
- Day la PHIEN THIET KE/PHAT HIEN - KHONG duoc tu sua code trong phien nay. Ket qua la danh sach van de
  + cach sua de xuat, Leader (Claude Code) se tu trien khai sau, roi mo 1 phien Council review rieng
  cho phan da sua - dung mau da lam voi 2 CR truoc.
- Neu khong tim thay van de that nao o 1 trong 3 khia canh, ky ro "khong phat hien van de o khia canh X"
  kem pham vi da doc, khong duoc bay ra van de gia cho co.
